sentence: This project designs genomic precision medicine work on a health condition in one region, aiming to improve health disparities.
This project offers shared brain imaging tools and behavior tests to researchers studying animal models of neurocognitive disorders.
This project studies how tumors and the nervous system interact, to address therapeutic challenges in cancers and neurologic disease.
This project builds a computer model from oral microbiome samples and tests whether it can predict Alzheimer's disease.
This project builds a microscope that captures how brain cells release and recycle tiny vesicles in living cells in real time.
This project tries to find out how the molecular toolkit of a cancer cell changes as cancer spreads through the body.
This project studies how cells coordinate choices that make different mRNAs, and tests what those choices do in human neurons.
This project develops ways to deliver gene therapy inside the body so B cells make antibodies that control HIV over a long time.
This project tests whether a block copolymer surfactant can help rodents survive radiation damage to the stomach and intestines.
This project uses electronic health record and genetic data to find genetic factors shared by chronic pain and internalizing psychiatric disorders.
This project tests how DNA damaging therapies change the immune response in different types of small cell lung cancer.
This project builds computer methods to find and model how human proteins interact with each other.
This project studies how environmental toxicants change chemical marks on RNA near chromatin, altering gene expression and possibly contributing to tumors.
This project tries to find out how a protein affects the way brain cells signal at synapses and how this relates to schizophrenia.
This project tests whether a type of immune cell called regulatory T cells makes lung cancers resist immunotherapy in mouse models.
This project tests the effects of many gene variants at once in fruit flies to learn which variants in a seizure-related gene cause disease.
This project uses CRISPR screens to test how common human gene differences affect responses to environmental exposures.
This project develops compounds that block a mitochondrial protein needed for growth of lymphomas that resist chemotherapy.
This project tries to find out how two kinds of T cells that react to tumors help the immune system fight tumors.
